title: Controlled document comprehension reference
provenance: Source-attributed controlled reference paraphrased from RFC 9110, published June 2022, sections 9.2.1 and 9.2.2. This narrow protocol comprehension task is not a representative web research benchmark. Verified against the RFC Editor text on 2026-10-18. Independent human review is required before a real study.

evidence.statement: A safe method is defined by essentially read-only requested semantics; incidental implementation side effects can still occur.
evidence.attribution: Fielding, Nottingham and Reschke, RFC 9110, section 9.2.1

evidence.statement: Idempotence concerns the intended server effect of multiple identical requests compared with one request; responses need not be identical.
evidence.attribution: Fielding, Nottingham and Reschke, RFC 9110, section 9.2.2

evidence.statement: Safe methods, PUT and DELETE are idempotent. General POST semantics do not guarantee idempotence.
evidence.attribution: Fielding, Nottingham and Reschke, RFC 9110, section 9.2.2
